message.content:
{
 "summary": "Coagulant pump P-202 is delivering less than commanded (FIT-202 well below P-202_SP) while the command rises as the controller tries to compensate, leading to clarified turbidity rising (AIT-401). The most likely causes are crystallised PAC in the injection quill or non-return valve, worn or stuck pump check valves, a ruptured diaphragm, a blocked suction strainer, air in the pump head, or an empty coagulant tank.",
 "likely_causes": [
  "Crystallised PAC in the injection quill or the non-return valve",
  "Worn or stuck pump check valves, or a ruptured diaphragm",
  "Suction strainer blocked, or air in the pump head",
  "Coagulant tank nearly empty"
 ],
 "checks": [
  "Check the coagulant day tank level LIT-202 to rule out an empty tank.",
  "Check the pump stroke and the discharge pressure gauge: high pressure points to a blocked quill, low pressure to a suction or valve problem.",
  "Do a drawdown test with the calibration column to measure the real delivered flow.",
  "Look at the injection quill for white crystalline deposits."
 ],
 "handover": "Coagulant pump P-202 active alarm for delivering less than commanded remains unacknowledged, with FIT-202 at 2.27 L/h and clarified turbidity AIT-401 at 16.5 NTU. Operator to complete checks for crystallised PAC, check valves, suction strainer, and tank level per SOP-04.",
 "citations": [
  "SOP-04 4.2",
  "SOP-04 4.3",
  "SOP-04 4.4",
  "SOP-09 9.3",
  "SOP-09 9.4"
 ]
}
